name: tutticode
description: Music as code for agents: write TuttiCode, render it to audio in your own browser, open it in TuttiDAW.

plugins.name: tutticode
plugins.description: Your agent writes music as code (a Strudel-compatible pattern language) and renders it to WAV, FLAC or MP3 with stems, an exact length and a loudness target, in your own browser on the TuttiDAW engine. Every render links to TuttiDAW to keep editing. Music beds, loops, stems and sound effects for videos, apps and games.
